name: Европейски пешеходен маршрут Е4, България
description_md:
European long distance walking route E4 in Bulgaria is a waymarked hiking route spanning 235.6 km. The difficulty is hard, derived from distance and ascent, with about 101 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule.

The route is signed as E4 and is part of the international waymarked hiking network. There are 13896 m of ascent and 12467 m of descent. It passes Seven Rila Lakes within 500 m.
